intro: The severed head of Kam Deepfury serves as grim proof that the Dark Iron conspirator behind the sabotaged Thandol Span has met his end. Slain within the riots of the Stormwind Stockade, his death fulfills a personal vendetta for the dwarven defenders of Dun Modr.

p: Kam Deepfury was arrested and locked away in the Stormwind Stockade for political reasons, spared from immediate execution by human diplomatic bureaucracy. To the Ironforge mountaineers stationed at Dun Modr, this restraint was unacceptable. Intelligence uncovered by Roggo revealed that Deepfury orchestrated the devastating attack on the Thandol Span—an assault that cost the lives of King Magni's soldiers and the kin of Longbraid the Grim. Bound by duty to remain at his post, Motley Garmason commissioned Alliance champions to infiltrate the rioting prison and claim Deepfury's head, ensuring true dwarven vengeance was delivered where human diplomacy faltered.
